hypothesis: Concealed geothermal faults missing from the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue occur as blind stepovers/relay ramps linking catalogue strands to off-catalogue USGS SGMC strands, with thermal springs marking upflow; permeability is hosted in the 300 m-1 km damage zone. Dots are placed strictly outside the 300 m catalogue collar (3 < d_catalogue <= 12 px) on SGMC-strand or spring support, at >= 2.8 px spacing, <= 37,654 binary dots.
mechanism: Catalogue faults are masked out of the competition scoring, so dots on/near mapped traces pay false-positive mass for no hidden truth (GEMSDOE32's +0.0070 came from deleting dots <= 2 px from the catalogue). BSD91 targets off-catalogue fault-associated ground no fleet lane targets systematically: DZEDGE used the annulus with no fault support (measured HOLDOUT-DTI 0.0 deliberate negative), SNAP snaps to catalogue-proximate edge crests, PRUNE refills from parent ridge support. Inter-dot spacing beyond the 300 m kernel radius keeps the matched-mass term M from self-cancelling.
